Exfiltrates logged keystrokes via abused Slack WebHooks
Takes screenshots using 'accessibility' PowerShell script and uploads them via ImgBB API
Exfiltrates plaintext passwords from password management or keychain tools
Uses postinstall commands to begin execution immediately after installation
Impacted Systems: Windows systems used by Solana crypto developers
Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages installed by developers
Abuse of Slack WebHooks and ImgBB APIs for data exfiltration
Indicators of Compromise: Trojan file named 'WebBrowser.exe' detected by VirusTotal
Strings referencing 'LOCKBITAI' username in Discord WebHooks
Postinstall command triggering execution on package install
